in_marathi.name: Chaitanya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaitanya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chaitanya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Chaitanya', meaning consciousness or awareness. In Hindu mythology, Chaitanya represents the divine consciousness that pervades the universe. This name is often given to a child to signify the divine awareness bestowed upon him or her.
